Preview: Preview shape: torus or fat (thicker) torus.
Filmthickness: Mean thin-film thickness in nanometres; sets the base interference colours (hundreds of nm gives rainbow hues).
Filmvariation: Noise-driven variation of film thickness in nanometres; higher = more colour change across the surface.
Filmior: Index of refraction of the thin film, e.g. 1.45 for oil.
Substrateior: Index of refraction of the surface under the film; changes the strength of the interference.
Iridescence: 0 = plain metallic reflection, 1 = full interference colour.
Fresnelpower: Exponent of the grazing-angle rim falloff; higher = rainbow rim confined closer to the silhouette.
Sheen: Strength of the anisotropic sheen highlights. 0 = off.
Anisotropy: Blend from round highlights (0) to stretched brushed-metal highlights (1).
Sheenexp: Sharpness of the sheen highlight; higher = tighter and shinier.
Brushangle: Direction of the brushed sheen in turns (0-1 = 0-360 degrees).
Oilscale: Frequency of the oil-slick thickness noise in world units; higher = finer swirls.
Oilmotion: Radius of the looping path the noise travels in; larger = more visible swirling over time. 0 = static.
Basecolor: Colour of the underlying surface; only a faint contribution since the look is mostly reflection.
Roughness: Blur of the environment reflection. 0 = mirror sharp.
Envrotation: Rotates the environment around the vertical axis, 0-1 = one full turn.
Envintensity: Brightness multiplier of the reflected environment.
Spin: Number of full preview rotations per animation cycle. 0 = no spin.
Camdistance: Preview camera distance in world units; larger = smaller object.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
